cells.quote: Exploratory meta-regression findings suggest that moderate-to-vigorous intensity, compared to moderate intensity, was associated with a small but significant improvement in working memory (β = 0.25, 95% CI [0.05 to 0.45], p = 0.02).
cells.note: The moderation evidence is an exploratory observational between-study comparison, not a causal comparison.

cells.quote: In contrast, aerobic PA with moderate to vigorous intensity benefitted executive function outcomes.

O.outcome_detail: MVPA decoding accuracy; above-chance discrimination from 100 to 420 ms

cells.quote: With respect to incongruent-self-reference and incongruent-non-self-reference, MVPA revealed a sig- nificant above-chance difference between the two classes from 100 to 420 ms after stimulus onset (p < 0.001, cluster-corrected, right-sided).

O.outcome_detail: MVPA decoding accuracy; above-chance discrimination from 80 to 580 ms

cells.quote: For congruent-self-reference and con gruent-non-self-reference, MVPA revealed a sig- nificant above-chance difference between classes of congruent-self-reference and incongruent-non-self-reference from 80 to 580 ms after stimulus onset ( p < 0.001, cluster-corrected, right-sided).
cells.note: The study text contains an apparent inconsistency in this sentence, referring to incongruent-non-self-reference in the latter class description. The entry reports the contrast as congruent-self-reference versus non-self-reference. No printed effect size is provided.

cells.quote: Regarding RT, a repeated measures ANOVA with 2 (congruency: congruent vs incongruent) × 2 (self-referential information: the self-reference condition“my” vs the non-self-reference condition “the”) yielded a significant interaction,F(1, 32) = 12.19,p = 0.001, ηp2 = 0.28. Specifically, self-reference condition (34.88 ms) reduced the CE compared to the non-self-reference condition (55.77 ms).
cells.note: The self-reference manipulation reduced the reaction-time congruency effect.

cells.quote: The main effect of self-referential information was significant, F(1, 32) = 7.16, p = 0.012, ηp2 = 0.18, indicating that the N2 amplitude evoked by non-self-reference condition (0.76, SE = 0.57) was significantly greater (more negative) than that evoked by self-reference condition (1.28, SE = 0.58), as shown in Fig. 2A.
cells.note: The self-reference condition elicited smaller N2 amplitude.

O.outcome_detail: stimuli-locked sustained-potential amplitude during conflict resolution

cells.quote: In the incongruent condition, there was a significant difference between self-reference and non-self-reference conditions, F(1,32) = 4.55, p = 0.041, suggesting that the SP amplitude evoked by non-self-reference condition (4.15, SE = 0.72) was greater (more positive) than that evoked by self-reference condition (3.27, SE = 0.65).
cells.note: Lower SP amplitude was interpreted by the authors as requiring fewer cognitive resources for conflict resolution.

O.outcome_detail: EEG MVPA decoding latency and above-chance classification

result.effect: p < 0.001, cluster-corrected; decoding onset 220 ms versus 340 ms

cells.quote: As depicted in Fig. 3A, regarding self-reference-congruent and self-reference-incongruent comparison, MVPA revealed a significant above-chance (AUC > 0.5) difference between the two classes from 220 to 1000 ms after stimulus onset (p < 0.001, cluster-corrected, both-sided). Similarly, for non-self-reference-congruent and non-self-reference-incongruent comparison, MVPA revealed a significant above-chance difference between the two classes from 340 to 1000 ms after stimulus onset (p < 0.001, cluster-corrected, both-sided).
cells.note: The authors conclude that the self-reference condition classified congruent and incongruent trials earlier than the non-self-reference condition.

cells.quote: Among boys, higher in-school MVPA was related to higher GPA.
cells.note: The study reports a positive association, not a manipulated treatment effect; the reported path was significant (p = .027).

cells.quote: In the same multigroup SEM with accelerometer-measured in-school MVPA, the boys' MVPA-to-GPA path was significant (p = .027) whereas the girls' path was not (p = .544).
